confidence_notes: Colombo cost-of-living observations provide a useful basis for meals, cappuccino, and domestic draft beer. Cocktail and wine prices are less certain and estimated from their typical price relationship to local beer and wine retail. Accommodation estimates are holistic and have wider uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Colombo-specific price observations anchor the food and coffee estimates. Accommodation estimates use general knowledge of Colombo budget guesthouses and urban hotels, without live listing data.
